Name: Cheap Joja Seeds
Author: lemurkat
Description:
Ever thought it weird how Joja is branded as "Cheap" but their seeds are so expensive?
Ever wanted to face the moral dilemma of price vs ethics?
Well, now's your chance!

With Cheap Joja Crops, your seeds will cost you less! 
What could be better, right?

There's one thing Pierre IS right about though - his seeds are better quality. Cheap Joja seeds will not produce prize-winning fruit or vegetables (the highest quality you'll grow is silver*) - but they'll fill your casks and preserving jars, just the same.

Drag and drop in your mods folder, and make the right decision. The Joja decision.

JUST IN!
We have finally found a source for flowers. Now you may grow your own seasonally appropriate flowers in the best color: blue!
Struggled with inventory size when harvesting your blooms? No need to worry now Joja Flowers are here - they only come in two shades (cyan and skyan)! 
And like the rest of our crops... Their quality ain't good, but the price is right.

Do you really love the color blue?
Now even your sunflowers can be that shade! Merely toggle it on in the config, or use GMCM.
Please note that whilst Joja Blue Sunflowers exhibit similar properties to regular sunflowers, they're their own established breed, and thus will not serve as a replacement in bundles or for gifts. Also note that their seeds are less fertile - they'll only drop half as often when harvesting**. But that's not a problem, because they're a great deal cheaper! 
Plus, did I mention... they're blue?


[b]ADDITIONAL FEATURES:[/b]

Contains built-in compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8804]CopperSun's Joja Blackmarket[/url] mod:
- Install the Content Patcher portion of the Blackmarket mod ([CP] Joja Blackmarket only.
- This mod ports the shop portion ([STF] part) to work with the 1.6 system. Some prices may vary.
- Blue Sunflower Seeds currently not available through the Blackmarket. They're so new they haven't made it there yet. ***

(Mods shown in the screenshots: Portraits for Vendors, Seasonally Cuter for Juliet and Jessie, Vibrant Pastoral Recolor, plus my mods Juliet & Jessie the Joja Clerks, and sneaking in there, Victoria from East Scarp).

* If you are looking to complete the Community Center, don't forget to buy some seeds from Pierre to fulfill those gold crop bundles. Or you could consider a Joja Membership instead? Far less hassle and far more haste! The world revolves around money, after all!

** Requires Spacecore, without Spacecore they will not drop any at all

*** aka I forgot to add them.
